decided: A newly set-up project gets one program pull request per architecture doc, written as a visible line in its settings; projects already set up keep what they have.
alternatives: a project with no setting at all gets program pull requests, changing existing projects on upgrade
no change to orbit; the user sets it in each of their own projects
why: New projects get the flow the user works in, where they can see and change it, and no existing project starts opening pull requests silently after an upgrade (R-adf-1).
